author: Joshua Fluke
description:
A viral recruiter says bringing an iced coffee to a job interview can make candidates look too casual and “unprofessional” — and somehow this has turned into a massive debate about hiring, Gen Z, and workplace professionalism.

Apparently your experience, qualifications, and ability to do the job matter… but so does whether your coffee has ice in it.

Then:
Recruiter Caitlin Wehniainen sparked the debate after saying candidates arriving at interviews with iced coffee or iced lattes can make the interview look like just another stop on their list of errands.

In this video, we're breaking down the viral iced coffee job interview controversy, recruiter assumptions, job interview etiquette, hiring-manager double standards, corporate professionalism, and the increasingly ridiculous unwritten rules candidates are expected to follow just to get hired.

Because if iced coffee is unprofessional, what exactly is acceptable?
Hot coffee? Water? A Stanley? Gatorade? A protein shake? An energy dri
title: ICED COFFEE CAN COST YOU A JOB NOW?!
